package storage

import (
	"bytes"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

type oldReaderVisitor struct{ visits int }

func (v *oldReaderVisitor) VisitNode(*Node) error { v.visits++; return nil }
func (v *oldReaderVisitor) VisitEdge(*Edge) error { v.visits++; return nil }
func TestOldReaderCompatibilityFixture(t *testing.T) {
	dir := os.Getenv("NORNICDB_RECOVERY_FIXTURE_DIR")
 require.NotEmpty(t,dir)
	path := filepath.Join(dir, "wal", "wal.log")
	before, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	wal, err := NewWAL(filepath.Dir(path), &WALConfig{SyncMode: "none"})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NoError(t, wal.Close())
	after, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	assert.Equal(t, before, after)
	entries, err := ReadWALEntries(path)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Len(t, entries, 1)
	engine := NewMemoryEngine()
	defer engine.Close()
	require.NoError(t, ReplayWALEntry(engine, entries[0]))
	node, err := engine.GetNode("test:a")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	assert.Equal(t, []string{"Doc"}, node.Labels)
	assert.Equal(t, float64(9007199254740992), node.Properties["integer"])
	snapshot, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, "snapshot.nds"))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	visitor := &oldReaderVisitor{}
	_, err = ReadSnapshot(bytes.NewReader(snapshot), visitor)
	assert.ErrorContains(t, err, "unsupported")
	assert.Zero(t, visitor.visits)
	_, err = LoadSnapshot(filepath.Join(dir, "snapshot.nds"))
	assert.Error(t, err)
	untouched, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, "snapshot.nds"))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	assert.Equal(t, snapshot, untouched)
}
